title: Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2020
ACT VII OF 2020
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN
FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Establishment of the Office
of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act,
1991
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
6th February, 2020]
NO. PAS/LEGIS-B-02/2020, dated
6.2.2020.---The Provincial
Assembly of Sindh in its sitting held on 08th January, 2020 passed the
Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh
(Amendment) Bill, 2020 and was sent to Honourable Governor for accord his
assent as required under clause (2)(a) of Article 116 but he, instead of accord
assent to the Bill, returned the same with message in exercise of powers vested
upon him under clause 2(b) of Article 116.
The
Provincial Assembly of Sindh in its sitting held on 23rd January, 2020
reconsidered the Bill and passed it again without any amendment which was
accordingly sent to the Governor for accord his assent. The period of ten days has
been elapsed and the subject bill shall be deemed to have been assented by the
Governor in view of clause (3) of Article 116 of the Constitution and is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the
Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act,
1991, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the
Province of Sindh (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

(Amendment) Bill, 2020 and was sent to Honourable Governor for accord his
assent as required under clause (2)(a) of Article 116 but he, instead of accord

Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the
Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act,

3. Amendment
of section 3 of Sindh Act No.I of 1992.---In the said Act, in section 3 -
(a) in
subsection (1), for the word "Governor", the words "Chief
Minister" shall be substituted;
(b) after
subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be inserted:-

The Ombudsman appointed under subsection (1) shall be a person who -
(a) has
been or is qualified to be a Judge of the High Court;
(b) has
remained civil servant of BS-20 or above; or
(c) is
of known integrity and social eminence.".
